create_datadog_cost_logger: create a DatadogCostManagementLogger instance to batch and upload LLM usage costs to Datadog Custom Costs API
log_llm_success_event: log an LLM success event with response cost to the Datadog batch logger queue for periodic upload
send_batched_costs: send a batch of aggregated LLM cost entries from the logger queue to the Datadog Custom Costs endpoint
aggregate_costs_by_provider_model_date: aggregate a list of LLM logging payloads by provider, model, date, and tags into Datadog FOCUS cost entries
upload_costs_to_datadog: upload aggregated cost entries as JSON to the Datadog Custom Costs API using API key and application key authentication
